mutator_gracetroll_longdesc:
Damage grace on players and AI crewmembers is changed to a specific value. Damage grace affects how often instances of damage are calculated, lower values will cause you to take more damage in a shorter amount of time.

NOTE: Custom Damage Grace value will be applied only if it is lower than difficulty based grace period.
